prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / matching companion card. Create ONE QUEEN OF DIAMONDS using the supplied Design 2 Queen of Spades as the authoritative visual reference. Preserve the exact 5:7 full-card composition, small elegant head-and-torso scale, broad graceful sleeves spanning the inner sides, Ming-inspired madder-red silk phoenix robe with gold cloud embroidery, teal-and-gold lotus-embroidered stole bands/cuffs, ivory inner collar, jade plaque belt, black upswept hair, compact gold-and-teal phoenix crown with pearls and red gemstones. Same naturalistic painted adult Chinese royal woman style, refined face and hands, luminous restrained shading, no facial hair. All four Queens share the same rich clothing palette; do not recolor the whole woman by suit.
Preserve the narrow gold lotus-vine outer frame, beaded inner rules, ivory margin and diagonal ivory index panels; dense teal/red/ivory/gold Chinese lotus ornament on BLACK interior ground, shaped ivory reserve with fine gold tracery, diagonal woven waist join and SMALL turquoise jewel at exact card center. Retain motif scale and density; no empty background or enlarged figure. Crown and every attribute safely inside the inner frame.
Exactly two opposing waist-up portraits of the SAME woman, with the bottom a precise 180-degree rotated counterpart of the upper. Same face, crown, hands, flower, robe, ornament and index under a half turn. Natural diagonal central join. Two hands per upright figure, graceful correct fingers; no extra inherited hands or staff parts.
Change the two corner indices to serif Q and the specified small PLAIN SOLID suit symbol, keeping the letter size, clear Q tail, panel positioning and rotated lower copy. No K letters, no names, captions or other text. One flat full-card PNG approximately 1060x1484, no mockup, other cards, scene, border-crossing ornaments, photo, anime, 3D or watermark.

DIAMONDS: Outer border ground MADDER LAKE RED #A73443 with the same gold vines; interior floral ground stays BLACK. Red Q and solid red diamond-rhombus indices.
MANDATORY PORTRAIT DIRECTION CHANGE: reverse the reference queen's head turn. The UPRIGHT queen's nose must point to VIEWER'S LEFT, toward the upper-left Q panel. BOTH EYES remain visible in a gentle three-quarter view, not strict profile. Do not keep the reference's rightward gaze. Distinct adult Chinese woman with a slightly longer oval face, refined straight brows and a composed reflective expression. Black hair arranged neatly under the compact Ming-inspired gold/teal phoenix crown. Add small diamond-shaped red gemstone settings and short pearl pendants to distinguish this queen, keeping crown scale and clear top margin.
REMOVE every part of the scepter. Hold ONE slender living lotus flower with pointed IVORY petals tipped MADDER RED, on a thin curved green stem in her hand on viewer's RIGHT. Blossom at shoulder height, about 6–7% of card width, small and elegant. Exactly one flower and two small green leaves, not a bouquet or staff finial. Fingers naturally pinch the stem, stem visible below the hand. Other hand lightly touches the upper robe. Preserve the same rich madder robe, gold phoenix embroidery, teal lotus bands and broad sleeves.
Lower woman and flower repeat under a precise 180-degree rotation. Maintain the exact 5:7 aspect of the supplied reference, target 1060x1484; do not make the card narrower or taller.
